LESSON: SELF- AWARENESS 1.0 CREATION

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.1: Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What is your name?

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:
